title: Wealth exchange under ceiling and flooring constraints: a modified Bennati-Dragulescu-Yakovenko model
summary: We investigate the classical Bennati-Dragulescu-Yakovenko (BDY) dollar exchange model introduced in \cite{dragulescu_statistical_2000} where the effects of wealth ceiling and wealth flooring are explored.
